1. This Petitioner/A.2 has filed the present Criminal Petition invoking the provision of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Procedure,, 1973 (for short,
'Cr.P.C.,') seeking pre-arrest arrest bail in the event of his arrest in connection wi with Crime No.50 of 2024 of Balaji Nagar Station, Nellore, SPSR Nellore District,
registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 354, 323, 506 r/w 34 of IPC.

sentences.text: Along with A.1 and A.2, A.3 also used to threaten the Defacto Complainant with dire consequences that he can kill her due to family disputes.
Thus, A.1 to A.3 harassed the Complainant physically and mentally.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the offences alleged against the Petitioners are punishable for imprisonment of less than seven years.

4. Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits the copy of the written instructions given by Inspector of Police, Balaji Nagar P.S., wherein the Investigating Officer states that the Accused persons are not available for serving the notice under section 41A of Cr.P.C., to them, later on contacting them over phone, they replied that they can appear before the Investigating officer on 14.03.2024 for complying the section 41A of Cr.P.C., notice.

5. Upon considering the submissions of both the learned counsel, this Court views that since the Investigating Officer has preferred to serve the notice under section 41A of Cr.P.C., against the Petitioners/A.1 to A.3, no further Orders need be passed and the written instructions given by the Investigating Officer are recorded.
6.
Accordingly, the Criminal petition is closed.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
